title: Review of c06 pcell-multilevel (SIDH, L7[L2]): replicated on seed 5; every death is a low-yield cell; Supported, with no population-level response and a linked marker
summary: Re-ran the world unchanged on seed 5 (labkit, T=100000) and the author's genealogy.py, deathsel.py and heredity.py on the same seed. Cells form from the noisy soup by t=4000 (sheet.png), persist at 22-30 cells and divide: labkit 20 persistent splits, generation 3, 1 merge; the particle genealogy gives 28 persistent splits, generation 5, 0 merges, 0 conversions, and 65 deaths with nothing imposed. All 64 scored deaths are below the living cells' median yield (mean percentile 0.039; 39/39 mature cells at 0.026), splitting cells sit at 0.63 (19/27 above the median), and daughters keep the parent's yield (r = 0.84, mean |change| 0.025 against a between-cell SD 0.10). The inert identical-event marker is biased the other way on this seed (death percentile 0.70), so with the author's seed 2 (0.29) it is biased on 2 of 4 seeds by linkage, but never near the yield's 0.02-0.05.

observations.S: rerun/seed5/sheet.png t=0: uniform soup, noisy phi everywhere
observations.I: rerun/seed5/sheet.png t=4000-100000: 22-30 discrete walled cells; FACTS 14 persistent tracks
observations.D: rerun/seed5/FACTS.md: 20 persistent splits, max generation 3, merge/split 0.03; data/gen_s5.log: 28 persistent splits, generation 5, 0 merges
observations.H: data/selection_s5.txt: 64/64 deaths below the median yield (percentile 0.039), splits at 0.627; marker zm deaths at 0.697; data/heredity_s5.txt: parent-daughter r 0.835

controls_run.H: identical-event inert marker zm in the same run (data/selection_s5.txt): no low-death bias (0.697)

verdicts.limitation: The trait is continuous, so 'kinds' are yield ranks; the population-mean yield does not move beyond the marker's drift (author's trajectories.png), so selection differentials are shown but not a response; the marker shares particle lineages with the yield and is biased on 2 of 4 seeds (0.29, 0.70); deaths outnumber splits because small buds count as new cells; one cost value and no dt or resolution test; one fresh seed.
